text:
Sam: Quick async — I pulled together the open postmortem ACTIONS for INC-762. Need to confirm: owners, final due dates, and any blockers before tomorrow's cross-team sync. Here's the list I have:

- POST-762-1: create canary rollback playbook  (owner: ?)  due: 2024-06-30
- POST-762-2: add tracing & latency histograms to runtime (owner: Priya?) due: 2024-07-02
- POST-762-3: evaluate model quality regression on recent deploy (owner: Marta) due: 2024-06-28
- POST-762-4: infra autoscale tuning & quota bump for dedicated pool (owner: Jordan) due: 2024-07-01
- POST-762-5: doc + runbook updates (owner: docs) due: 2024-07-03

Can owners please confirm or correct and call out blockers? If you want a different due date say so. I plan to update the tracker by noon PT if no objections.

Priya: I'll own POST-762-2 (tracing/latency). Confirmed. Targeting 2024-07-02.
PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4098
Will need Jordan to merge (infra config) — tagging here. :thumbsup:

Jordan: I can own POST-762-4 (autoscale + quota). 2024-07-01 looks doable but note we have the dedicated pool maintenance window next week (2024-06-29) which may shift testing to 6/30. Blocker: need approval on quota bump from finance (ticket FIN-332).

Marta: I'll take POST-762-3. Current blocker: I don't have read access to the replay S3 bucket for the failing prompts (bucket: s3://inc762-replays). Filed IAM ticket `IAM-1219` — Kai, can you help expedite? Due: 2024-06-28.

Kai: Granted `s3:GetObject` for Marta on s3://inc762-replays — IAM-1219 resolved, access should work now. I also added a short policy note in the ticket about least-privilege. ETA: I ran a quick `aws s3 ls` test, looks good.

deploy-bot: Deployed commit 7a2b8c1 to staging at 2024-06-05T14:23:10Z — no errors reported.

oncall-bot: Incident timeline: https://redwood-inference.incident/INC-762/timeline — last major event 2024-06-04T22:11:03Z.

Priya: Quick note — for the tracing change I'm adding a toggle so we can roll it out separately per route. That should reduce impact risk.

Jordan: Re: FIN-332 — finance asked for a cost justification doc. Sam, can you or product add a short note on expected $$ savings from autoscaling so I can attach?

Sam: Yep, I'll add a 1-paragraph justification to the tracker and link it here by EOD.

Jordan: Also FYI PR for autoscale config is #4123 — would appreciate a quick review after I open it.

Priya: @Jordan please ping me on PR #4123 when it's up. I'll do the config + perf review.

Marta: Access works, thanks Kai. Started dataset diff run, will post findings in the thread. Pinging @Alex for help with the eval harness — Alex, can you review the harness config?

Alex: On it, will look now and reply with a tiny patch if needed.

Sam: Summary/next steps: everyone who said yes is owner. Finalize PRs and docs, I will update the tracker by noon PT (link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/INC-762-tracker) with these owners/dates and mark FIN-332 as a dependency. If anything changes, reply here before 2024-06-10T12:00:00-07:00 or I won't move dates.

Priya: 👍

Jordan: ack, will update FIN ticket with the cost blurb once Sam posts it.

Marta: will post eval results by EOD tomorrow and flag if we need more time.

Sam: thanks all — closing async check. If blockers pop up we can escalate to the oncall rotation.
